close_reason: Decision: extras-preservation + helper-function approach is sufficient. The existing #[serde(flatten)] extra: Map on every data object struct already captures metadata/privateMetadata properties on the wire and round-trips them correctly. jmap-metadata-client provides filter-condition builders and /changes helpers; jmap-metadata-server provides depth validation and filter predicates. No typed fields needed on extension-types structs.
description:
Add metadata/privateMetadata typed fields to JMAP data object types in extension-types crates that opt in to the metadata capability.

**What changes:**
- jmap-types: May need a MetadataMap type alias or newtype for the namespace-keyed map shape (serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> or HashMap<String, Value>)
- Each opted-in extension-types crate (starting with jmap-mail-types as canonical): add Option<MetadataMap> metadata and Option<MetadataMap> private_metadata fields with skip_serializing_if to the relevant data object types
- Each opted-in extension-types FilterCondition type: add the 6 new metadata filter condition fields (all Option)
- Each opted-in extension-types Property enum: add Metadata and PrivateMetadata variants

**Scope decision needed:** Which extension-types crates opt in? The spec says any JMAP data type can opt in. Start with mail-types (canonical template) and propagate per the canonical-template rule.

**Spec reference:** draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §2.1, §2.2, §2.4, §3.1
notes: Scope decision needed: which extension-types crates opt in to metadata-02? The bead suggests starting with mail-types as canonical, but deploying metadata fields (metadata + privateMetadata + 6 filter conditions + 2 Property variants) across all 7 sibling type crates is a significant API surface expansion. Options: (a) mail-types only as canonical, propagate to siblings in a follow-up; (b) all 7 siblings in one pass; (c) mail-types + chat-types (the two normative references) only. Recommendation: option (a) — canonical first, propagate after validation.
title: Integrate metadata-02 into foundation and extension type crates
